headlines.title: Voters sound off about the economy ahead of critical midterm elections
headlines.description: Voter feelings about the economy could be the deciding factor in who wins control of Congress in November. NBC News' Hallie Jackson traveled to several key states to ask voters there how they feel the economy is, in their own words.

headlines.title: Trump and Obama rally supporters in key battleground states ahead of midterms
headlines.description: President Trump and former President Obama both took to Michigan this weekend to rally supporters in the key battleground state ahead of midterms. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports from Michigan.

headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidate Mary Peltola delays campaign events after car crash
headlines.description: Anchorage police confirmed a crash involving three vehicles occurred Saturday and said those involved sustained “non-life threatening” injuries.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: Seahawks defense dominates Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III in big win
headlines.description: Seattle’s elite defense held Kansas City to its fewest total yards, first downs and red zone drives in any Mahomes start.

headlines.title: Crackdown in the West Bank days ahead of Israeli elections
headlines.description: The IDF ordered new restrictions on the West Bank ahead of Israeli elections this week. It’s focused on the city of Hebron, where Palestinian gunmen killed two IDF soldiers Friday. It comes just days before nationwide elections could determine Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s political future. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports from Tel Aviv.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Seahawks defense dominates Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III in big win
headlines.description: Seattle’s elite defense held Kansas City to its fewest total yards, first downs and red zone drives in any Mahomes start.

headlines.title: Trump leans into Islamophobic rhetoric at Michigan rally
headlines.description: The president attacked Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee who is locked in a dead heat against Republican Mike Rogers.

headlines.title: No risk of ammonia contamination, officials say, after fire at Oregon seafood plant
headlines.description: The fire erupted Sunday morning at Pacific Seafood, a major seafood processing and distribution plant. The city of Newport earlier warned of “extreme danger in the area.”

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Former President Barack Obama, appearing in Ohio Saturday at his first campaign rally for the midterm elections, characterized President Donald Trump as an agent of “chaos and cruelty” and a man of broken promises.

headlines.title: Kimi Antonelli wins U.S. Grand Prix in Texas, putting him on the brink of F1 championship
headlines.description: It was a masterful race weekend from the 20-year-old Italian, who is very likely to clinch the 2026 Formula 1 driver’s title next weekend in Mexico City.
